context: A mom and son chat after watching a film
purpose: Teach: 悲鳴/若き/のぞい/いただか/むろん/彦/晃/泰

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、映画の最後、悲鳴の場面、怖かった!
lines.en: Mom, that scream scene at the end really scared me!
lines.style: Breathless excitement mixed with residual fear. Voice climbing on "scared." Eyes wide. A child processing adrenaline in real time, needing to tell an adult immediately.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 若き俳優の演技、迫力あったわね。
lines.en: That young actor's performance had real force behind it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, appreciative nod in her voice. Calm reassurance underneath—a mother validating what he felt while showing it wasn't *too* much. Steady warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 廊下からのぞいてた人物、誰だったんだろう。
lines.en: I wonder who that was—the person looking out from the hallway?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, still a touch unsettled. Voice lifting slightly on the question. Not asking for comfort now—asking because his mind is working it out. Observant child.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんからは、解説聞いていただかなきゃね。
lines.en: We should ask your dad about that part—he'd explain it better.
lines.style: Gentle redirection without dismissal. Knowing glance in the tone—recognizing this question is beyond quick answers. Inviting him to share the movie with his father too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 怖い演出、むろん技術がいるんでしょ?
lines.en: Creating something that scary takes real skill, doesn't it?
lines.style: Slight pause before answering, like she's realizing her son just said something perceptive. Affirming the seriousness of his observation. A warm acknowledgment that he's thinking like an artist, not just a frightened child.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。主人公の彦って役名、印象的だったわね。
lines.en: Yes. The main character's name—Hiko—that really stayed with me.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. Lingering on the memory of the film. Gentle teacher voice—showing him that good movies live in details. Quiet appreciation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 監督の晃さん、独特な人らしい。
lines.en: Director Akira-san must have a real vision. That's what makes him different.
lines.style: Bright recognition—she's pleased he's picking up on directorial style. Not condescending. Enthusiastic but not performative. A mother and son talking about films like people who notice things.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 撮影監督は泰さん、彼の作品好きなの。
lines.en: The cinematographer—Yasushi-san—his work is beautiful. I really do love what he does.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. A moment of her own love for cinema showing through. Speaking more to herself than to him, but letting him hear it. The kind of honesty that makes a child feel grown-up.
